Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
systemd-run --unit=qsb-validation-auto-stop --on-active=90m /sbin/shutdown -h now
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update > /var/log/qsb-bootstrap.log 2>&1
apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl xz-utils python3 python3-boto3 docker.io >> /var/log/qsb-bootstrap.log 2>&1
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/node-v22.23.2-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/qsb-node.tar.xz
printf '%s  %s\n' d60acfe00a2932254bb0ad20e01b0d74397a0875595de719654b214f4b03f307 /tmp/qsb-node.tar.xz | sha256sum -c -
mkdir -p /opt/qsb-node
tar -xJf /tmp/qsb-node.tar.xz --strip-components=1 -C /opt/qsb-node
ln -s /opt/qsb-node/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node
ln -s /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python
rm /tmp/qsb-node.tar.xz
printf '%s' '${SourceCommit}' > /etc/qsb-validation-source
